definitions.logged_valid: CRC-valid envelopes present in packet_log; comparable to original summary.
definitions.forensic_raw_valid: All independently CRC-valid raw candidates, including overlaps missed by original live framer; never substituted into original statistics.
definitions.missing_updates: Conditional on accepted valid outer envelopes; excludes wholesale rejected candidates.
definitions.main_time: Original PC packet-completion timestamp, not raw byte arrival or device physical scan time.
